facts.business: The company previously provided electronic security services and solutions (CCTV, fire and intrusion alarm, access control) across BFSI, e-commerce, retail, and pharma verticals but has sold off the securities business and is exploring newer avenues.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1) Recovery order from EPFO amounting to Rs. 60.36 Lakhs with interim stay from High Court of Karnataka; 2) Interest free loans of Rs. 811.35 lakhs not accounted at amortised cost per Ind AS 109.

Non-compliance with Ind AS 109 for interest free loans of Rs. 811.35 lakhs
Business transition risk after sale of securities business
Capital structure constraints for new business opportunities
